high_level_description: This image captures the interior of a modern, spacious building with a high, glass-enclosed ceiling that allows natural light to flood the area. The architecture features intricate metal frameworks and a large, curved white structure that adds a futuristic touch to the space. In the foreground, there is a sleek, silver sports car with yellow accents prominently displayed on a raised platform. The car's design is aerodynamic, with sharp lines and a low profile, suggesting it is a high-performance vehicle. The Ferrari emblem is visible on the front, indicating the brand.
